meta.notes: sql_for('ma_dist_50'). Inputs are JSON and each case is recomputed from them; a raise is stored as {"raises": {"type", "message"}} (pydantic: "errors" instead of "message"). Polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}; pandas frames add index and write NA/NaN/NaT as null. Prices: close is adjusted, close_raw is the exchange print (house rule 6). Regenerate with `.venv/bin/python ../tools/parity/golden_ranking.py` from decile-blueprint.

output: CASE WHEN ma_50 > 0 THEN (close / ma_50 - 1) * 100 END
